# Ink Paper

Ink Paper styles a vault as a tactile paper workspace using warm Flexoki colors, readable typography and a translucent interface that lets a paper texture run across panes and sidebars. The recorded description names a Paper Engine for mixing base color, texture images and blend modes, a Swatch Shield that blocks transparent color pickers, and modular card layouts with independent panel colors.

![Ink Paper screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dsvictor/Ink-Paper/HEAD/assets/01.png)
